differentiation: Chosen over a folded V, an observation frame and a wordmark with index spur for its stronger connection to field movement. No trademark clearance performed.
provenance: Original vector contours and custom outline lettering.
rationale: An open contour corridor evokes walking a survey route and keeping one continuous record.
title: Transect
tradeoffs: At small sizes prefer the mark. Use reverse on dark backgrounds. Abstract contour geometry may evoke water without notebook context.
visual_system: Two original cubic forms in pine and spruce with custom outlined lettering and warm paper.
